# T-1: Add built-in agent resolution

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Expose package built-in profiles/providers as runtime defaults that validation and agent resolution can share without copying them into config.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R4 built-in `agent.useProfile` names resolve without config-local `agent.profiles`.
- R4 user-defined profiles/providers override built-ins by key.
- R8 existing concrete provider keys in `agent.default` remain resolvable.

## Implementation Notes
Update `src/lib/agent-defaults.js` role/API as the built-in source of truth. Wire `src/lib/config.js`, `src/lib/agent.js`, and any needed `ProviderRegistry` boundary so validation and runtime use the same built-in data.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local and shared unit coverage for built-in useProfile validation, unknown profile rejection, user override precedence, and Agent.resolve behavior.
